bed_event_evaluation.sample_size_note: There are only 2 annotated bed exits and 2 annotated bed returns (4 positive events); one miss changes per-kind recall by 50 percentage points. These counts cannot support strong claims.
bed_event_evaluation.matching_rule: One-to-one nearest same-kind event matching using confirmed_time.
bed_event_evaluation.reference_trace_note: The GT-segment detector run uses a deterministic state trace constructed from gt_events.csv event intervals and notes. It is an annotation-derived idealized trace, not an independently frame-labeled reconstruction; trap behavior is encoded from the annotated notes.
bed_event_evaluation.timing_error_definition: Predicted timestamp minus annotated timestamp; detection delay is predicted confirmed_time minus annotated start_time. Detector latency is predicted confirmed_time minus predicted start_time.
bed_event_evaluation.trap_matching_rule: A trap is counted as triggered when a detected bed_exit interval overlaps the annotated not_an_exit interval.
bed_event_evaluation.unannotated_trap_note: UNKNOWN blip is not one of the 3 gt_events.csv negative traps; the existing test_unknown_two_second_blip_does_not_create_exit unit test covers that case separately.
